title: Equil - connect timeout
symptom: In version 3.2.4.5, when attempting to perform a bolus, even through the calculator, there is no connection. The timer counts down, but no insulin is delivered. The same situation occurs when attempting to change the reservoir.
cause: A regression introduced between versions 3.4.2.2 and 3.4.2.3 caused the issue, which was addressed by changes in the dev3 branch.
fix: Build from the dev3 branch with the specific commit 03ea9f72f5ef45dc8e9d1fef9e5213df6180f9f8, which fixed the bolus and reservoir change issues. Version 3.4.2.6 was released with the fix.
evidence_quote: Something that appeared between 3.4.2.2 and 3.4.2.3 is causing the problem.
